content.text:
I'm going with **עוקב מדד S&P 500** (קופה 13414). I'm fairly sure. What decided it was seeing the name "S&P 500", the thing everyone at work talks about. It also had the biggest returns on the page: "13.7% 3 שנים" and "11.92% 5 שנים". So my 30,000 ₪ should grow nicely. The fee, "0.56% מההיסכון" and "0% מההפקדות", looks like basically nothing, and every track has about the same fee anyway.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **Screen 1:** the big heading "הראל", then the tab "קופת גמל להשקעה 16", which was already selected, so this is the right place. Then the table. The first two rows, "אשראי ואג"ח" and "מניות סחיר", had no returns, just "פחות מ־3 שנים".
- **Screen 2:** I scrolled down the track names on the right. I stopped at "עוקב מדד S&P 500" because of the big green 13.7% and "2.3 מיליארד ₪", so lots of people are in it. Most of the rows around it are "פחות מ־3 שנים" again. "כספי (שקלי)" has 4.25%, "קיימות" 1.78%, and "אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות" 8.6%. All lower.
- **Screen 3:** a line about "התקרה בחוק: 1.05%… 4%", which I skipped. Same with the grey text about "תשואת עבר". After that comes a list of folds under "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל". I didn't open any of them.
- **Screen 4:** more folds and a search box. Nothing there for me, so I stopped.

**Words I didn't get**
- "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח": I think it means how much is in shares. I had no idea what "מט"ח 99%" means.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים": I guess the track is new and has no numbers yet.
- The tags "עוקב מדדי אג"ח" and "הלכה יהודית".
- "123 מקור / 123 מחושב".

**Where I hesitated**
- I'm not sure I saw every row. The bottom of screen 2 and the top of screen 3 cut off in the middle. There's a "הלכה יהודית" row with "5.73%" whose name I never saw.
- "עוקב מדדי מניות" sounds almost the same as the S&P one. It has a bigger fee number (305 מיליון), but no returns are shown, so I went with S&P.
- I don't know what "the first thing to do" is. There's no button anywhere to open the קופה or contact Harel.

**What bothered me**
- 16 tracks that mostly look identical, all 0.56–0.58% and 0%. I'd never have picked one if the S&P name weren't there.
- Most rows show no return at all, just "פחות מ־3 שנים".
- The fee is only in percent. It doesn't tell me how many shekels that is on my 30,000.
- The cut-off rows between screens.
